coin.specsText:
Silver coin “Aerial Cableway Titlis” The silver coin “Aerial Cableway Titlis” is the second coin in the trilogy on the theme of “Swiss aerial cableways”. Titlis project: “Titlis” silver coin With its more than 3000-meter-high summit, the Titlis is one of Switzerland’s most internationally renowned excursion destinations. With the new silver coin we celebrate the aerial cableway Titlis with its new Titlis project, which will create a USP (Unique Selling Proposition) for Engelberg and the region. This project includes the new construction of the top station, the extension of the directional tower and a new single-track aerial tramway on the Stand-Titlis line. In the medium and long term, it will contribute to Engelberg’s success as a four-season destination. The competitive position of the Titlis as an excursion destination is world-renowned and will be strengthened in the long term. The 20g special coin “Titlis”, made of silver 999, stands out among other things with the impressively detailed obverse, showing part of the mountain massif as well as the cabin of the mountain railway. On the reverse, the Titlis mountain massif is visible. Additionally, the face value of CHF 20 is shown.
